newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-YEBOAH OUT AGAIN WITH HAMSTRING INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YEBOAH OUT AGAIN WITH HAMSTRING INJURY.

text.p: Tony Yeboah will miss Leeds United's English Football Association (F.A.) Cup third-round replay against Crystal Palace on Saturday with a hamstring injury, club physiotherapist Alan Sutton said on Wednesday.
The Ghana striker is still being treated for the injury that flared up again when he played for his country against Morocco in a World Cup qualifier earlier this month.
Sutton said Yeboah was undergoing medical tests and it was not yet known how long he would be out of action.

The 30-year-old striker was criticised by the club's chairman for his decision to play for Ghana despite missing Leeds' last premier league match through injury and admitting he was not 100 percent fit.
